scripts.dev:ai: if [ -f apps/ai-service/.venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then apps/ai-service/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/ai-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; else uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/ai-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; fi
scripts.test:ai: if [ -f apps/ai-service/.venv/bin/pytest ]; then apps/ai-service/.venv/bin/pytest apps/ai-service/tests; else pytest apps/ai-service/tests; fi
